name: Picenadol
summary: Picenadol (LY-97435) is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is an opioid analgesic drug developed by Eli Lilly in the 1970s. Picenadol is an effective analgesic with similar efficacy to pethidine (meperidine). It has been investigated for some applications such as obstetrics and dentistry, but never commercialised.

pharmacology.text: It is unusual in that one enantiomer is a pure μ-opioid agonist, while the other is an antagonist. The (3R,4R) isomer is the agonist, while (3S,4S) is antagonist.

uses.text: Picenadol (LY-97435) is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is an opioid analgesic drug developed by Eli Lilly in the 1970s. It has been investigated for some applications such as obstetrics and dentistry, but never commercialised.

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Because of its mixed action, its effects reach a ceiling rather than growing without limit.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。由於它的混合作用，其效果會達到上限，而不會無止境增強。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。由于它的混合作用，其效果会达到上限，而不会无止境增强。

fact.en: It is a rare case where a drug's two mirror-image forms do opposite things: one activates the μ-opioid receptor and the other blocks it, so the mixture partly cancels itself out.
fact.zh: 它是罕見的例子，兩種鏡像異構物作用相反：一種活化 μ 型鴉片受體，另一種則阻斷它，因此混合物會部分互相抵銷。
fact.zhHans: 它是罕见的例子，两种镜像异构物作用相反：一种活化 μ 型鸦片受体，另一种则阻断它，因此混合物会部分互相抵销。
